message.reasoning: We need to fill fuel tank. The tank holds up to 50 gallons. Current fuel level is 10 liters. We need to convert to gallons? The function fillFuelTank expects fuelAmount in gallons. We need to determine how many gallons to add to reach full capacity. But we don't know current gallons. We have 10 liters. Convert liters to gallons: 1 liter = 0.264172 gallons. So 10 liters = 2.64172 gallons. Tank capacity 50 gallons. So need to add 47.35828 gallons. But we might just fill to capacity: fillFuelTank with fuelAmount = 50 - current gallons. But we don't know current gallons. We can approximate: 10 liters ~ 2.64 gallons. So need about 47.36 gallons. Let's call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount 47.36.
